canonical_record.name: Barrier
canonical_record.brief_description: Shields your champion briefly to absorb incoming damage.
canonical_record.full_description: Barrier grants your champion a short-duration shield that scales by level and absorbs damage before health is lost.

active_effects.label: spell_active
active_effects.description: Shield your champion for 110-450 based on level for 2 seconds.

when_to_choose: Against burst lanes, assassin all-ins, and situations where self-survival is more important than ally utility.

when_to_avoid: If you need team utility, anti-dive damage reduction, or crowd-control cleansing more.

canonical_record.name: Exhaust
canonical_record.brief_description: Reduces an enemy champion’s damage and slows them for a short duration.
canonical_record.full_description: Exhaust targets an enemy champion, reducing their damage output and applying a decaying slow for 2.5 seconds.

active_effects.label: spell_active
active_effects.description: Exhaust the target enemy champion for 2.5 seconds, reducing damage dealt by 40% and slowing by 60% decaying over the duration.

when_to_choose: Against assassins, burst divers, short-range all-in champions, and carry-protection lanes.
why_to_choose: Directly denies enemy damage windows and creates peel value.
when_to_avoid: If the primary threat is poke, map pressure, or hard CC that Cleanse would answer better.

canonical_record.name: Ghost
canonical_record.brief_description: Gives a burst of movement speed that decays over time and refreshes on champion takedown.
canonical_record.full_description: Ghost grants movement speed for 8 seconds, decaying to 25% bonus movement speed. Champion takedowns extend the duration by 6 seconds and refresh the effect up to the original duration.

active_effects.label: spell_active
active_effects.description: Gain movement speed for 8 seconds; takedowns extend and refresh the movement-speed effect.

when_to_choose: Extended fights, kiting patterns, melee chase, juggernaut access, and jungle/top lane mobility plans.
why_to_choose: Higher uptime than Flash-style burst mobility and strong reset value after takedowns.
when_to_avoid: When instant blink safety is required more than long-duration movement speed.

canonical_record.name: Heal
canonical_record.brief_description: Heals you and the most wounded nearby ally, then grants both a brief movement-speed boost.
canonical_record.full_description: Heal restores health to your champion and the most wounded nearby allied champion, grants both champions bonus movement speed for a short duration, and applies reduced restoration to champions recently affected by Heal.

recent_heal_reduction.raw: 50% less health on recently affected champions

active_effects.label: spell_active
active_effects.description: Heal for 100-390 based on level to yourself and the most wounded nearby allied champion; both gain 30% bonus movement speed for 1 second.

passive_effects.label: recent_heal_penalty
passive_effects.description: Champions affected by Heal recently cause later Heal casts on them to restore 50% less health.

when_to_choose: Duo/support situations where saving an ally or stabilizing a skirmish matters.
Compositions that benefit from short movement-speed bursts for kite, chase, or disengage.
why_to_choose: Adds immediate defensive value without requiring damage timing.
Pairs naturally with shield/heal synergies and enchanter playstyles.
when_to_avoid: If the enemy has heavy anti-heal pressure and your team needs Exhaust or Cleanse more.
If your lane partner already carries Heal and duplication reduces value.
